stories.title: Jon Rahm Exits LIV Golf — Gives Up $100M Over "Unacceptable" Terms

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Jon Rahm is DONE with LIV Golf.

His attorney told bankruptcy court he found the terms for LIV's 2027 relaunch "unacceptable."

He's walking away from roughly $100 million still owed to him.

The biggest name in LIV is out. #Golf #LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
When Rahm left the PGA Tour for LIV Golf, he was the biggest deal in golf.

Now he's leaving LIV — giving up $100M — after the league filed for bankruptcy in September.

Two-time major champion. On the move again. #Golf #JonRahm

stories.title: LIV Golf's Collapse: Chapter 11, $500M in Debt, and the Road to 2027

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on September 8, 2026.

$500M+ in debt. Saudi PIF pulled funding after spending $5 billion over 5 years.

Plans to relaunch in 2027 as a smaller 75-player tour with BC Partners. #Golf #LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf's bankruptcy voided player contracts.

Rahm is out. The future is a smaller 75-player tour — if it launches at all.

Saudi Arabia's $5 billion experiment is over. #Golf #LIVGolf

stories.title: What's Next for Jon Rahm? A Path from LIV to the DP World Tour — and Eventually the PGA Tour

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Jon Rahm is out of LIV Golf. So what's next?

Reports say: DP World Tour in 2027.

PGA Tour return would require a 1-year wait from his last LIV event — potentially 2028 at the earliest.

The comeback tour starts in Europe. #Golf #JonRahm
